# Jeremiah 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-the-fourth year of-Jehoiakim son-of Josiah king-of Judah, came this word to Jeremiah from-YHWH, saying:

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**11** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**17** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**23** And-it-was when-Jehudi had-read three or-four columns, he-cut-it with the-scribe's knife and-cast-[it]-into the-fire which [was]-in-the-firepot, until all the-scroll was-consumed in-the-fire which [was] in-the-firepot.

**24** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**25** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**26** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**27** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**28** "Take again another scroll and-write upon-it all the-former words which were on the-first scroll which Jehoiakim king-of Judah burned."

**29** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**30** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**31** And-YHWH spoke concerning the burned scroll through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

**32** And-Jeremiah took another scroll and-gave-it to Baruch son-of Neriah the-scribe, and-he-wrote upon-it from-[the]-mouth-of Jeremiah all the-words-of the-scroll which Jehoiakim king-of Judah had-burned in-the-fire; and-many similar words were-added to-them.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **36:1**: Opening formula for the the burned scroll oracle. Historical and prophetic setting established.

- **36:16**: Central imagery of rewritten word — a defining element of this chapter's prophetic message.

- **36:32**: Concluding formula — ne'um YHWH. The divine speech seal.

— EMET
